## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `291ef83d8296d6445c4620aa22dc93c98dad9957`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md + .changeset/objectui-i18n-guide-locale-tags.md, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/i18n.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts, ui/packages/i18n/package.json, ui/packages/i18n/tsconfig.json, packages/spec/src/system/platform-locales.ts, packages/spec/src/system/index.ts, packages/spec/package.json, packages/spec/src/ui/i18n.zod.ts, packages/skills/package.json, skills/objectui/evals/i18n.json, skills/objectui/SKILL.md, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, PR #30902 (merged as `5bca14fc2`)

Inputs: card #30911 body and its 2 comments (triage, claim); PR #31043 body and file list (2 files, +19 −17); the net diff `origin/main...291ef83d8` (merge base `9d939c582`, the current `origin/main`); the head's check-runs. Cited code read on `origin/main` `9d939c582`.

### ① Derived judgments

Every tag, key, path, API name and behaviour the guide now teaches, against `main`:

- **The eleven tags, in order** (L30: `en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`). Exact. `platform-locales.ts` `ROWS` has these 11 tags in this order, and `registry.ts` `LAZY_LOCALE_LOADERS` (typed on `PlatformLocaleTag`) plus `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES = [...PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS]` key the packs by them. The order is the table's menu order, not the old guide's grouping.
- **"One pack per row … keyed by tag"** (L29–30). True. `locales/index.ts` `builtInLocales` has exactly these keys, held to the table with `satisfies Record` on `PlatformLocaleTag`.
- **`PLATFORM_LOCALES` from `@objectstack/spec/system`** (L29, L40). True. It is exported by `platform-locales.ts`, re-exported at `system/index.ts:131`, and `packages/spec/package.json` publishes `./system` (import, require and browser arms). The `objectui` SKILL.md `compatibility:` line already requires `@objectstack/spec` 18.x, so the extra import needs no install step.
- **The module path for each tag** (L31). Every one resolves. `ui/packages/i18n/package.json` exports `./locales/*` → `./dist/locales/*.js`. `tsconfig.json` sets `rootDir: src` and `outDir: dist`, and `src/locales/` holds `en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko` `.ts`. There is no `zh.ts` or `pt.ts`, so the retired paths really do not resolve. The setup and switcher imports (`@object-ui/i18n` for `I18nProvider`, `createI18n` and `useObjectTranslation`) resolve through `.` in `src/index.ts`.
- **"No `zh` or `pt` pack"** (L31). True of keys and modules. `index.ts` says "there is no `zh` or `pt` key". The `@object-ui/i18n/locales` door still exports JS identifiers named `zh` and `pt`, but the source says these are identifiers, not pack keys. The sentence stays true.
- **Read aliases: `zh` and `zh-CN` → `zh-Hans`, `zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`, `pt` → `pt-BR`** (L31–32). Exact. `PLATFORM_LOCALE_READ_ALIASES` holds each of these rows. `resolveBuiltInLanguage` (`registry.ts`) reads them through `platformLocaleTagOf`, and the package entry exports it, so the name in parentheses is real and importable. The provider and `createI18n` also serve an alias-language instance through `fallbackLanguagesFor`. The guide does not need that detail.
- **"Write the tag."** (L33). True. `platform-locales.ts` says the aliases are "Reads only: a new write uses the table tag itself".
- **Setup `resources: { 'zh-Hans': … }`** (L14). Correct. `createI18n` deep-merges `resources[lang]` over each `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` bundle, so the `zh-Hans` key merges into the built-in pack. The old `zh` key would now have formed a separate non-built-in bundle. With `detectBrowserLanguage`, a `zh-CN` browser resolves to `zh-Hans` through `pickInitialLanguage` → `resolveBuiltInLanguage`.
- **Switcher** (L49–51): `PLATFORM_LOCALES.map(({ tag, label }) => …)`. The fields are real: the `PlatformLocale` interface declares `tag`, `label` and `rtl`. `changeLanguage(tag)` loads the built-in catalogue under its tag (`provider.tsx` context `changeLanguage` → `loadBuiltInLocale(resolveBuiltInLanguage(lang))`). See S1 for one gap in the `value` binding.

The four restatement deletions:

1. L3 intro "Multi-language support via `@object-ui/i18n`." The surviving home is real: the package name is in the H1 subject and in every fence's import, first at Setup L6. No unique fact was lost.
2. `// Auto-detect from navigator`. The surviving home is real: the option is named `detectBrowserLanguage`, and `I18nConfig` documents it as "Whether to detect browser language automatically (default: true)". `pickInitialLanguage` reads `navigator.language`. No fact was lost.
3. The RTL fence `const { direction } = useObjectTranslation(); // direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl'`. The surviving home is real: the hook example (L43, L46) destructures `direction` and applies `dir={direction}`, the RTL prose keeps "The provider updates `document.dir`", and Common mistakes keeps `dir={direction}`. The `'ltr' | 'rtl'` union now appears nowhere in the guide, but it is the declared type of `getDirection` and of the context's `direction`, and the guide only ever passes the value to `dir`. No consequential teaching was lost.
4. Common-mistakes bullet "Bundling all locale files upfront — use lazy loading…". The surviving home is real and says the same thing: § Lazy language loading L60, "For large apps, load translations on demand instead of bundling all locales". No fact was lost.

No statement in the diff is false, and no unique fact was lost.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` is right. The diff changes only skill prose, and `packages/skills` publishes the synced `skills/` catalogue (`sync-catalog.mjs`, `files: ["dist", …]`). AGENTS.md says "`none` takes **`patch`**", and the recent skills-docs changesets on `main` (e.g. `29506-title-format-refused-teaching.md`) use the same shape. `skip-changeset` would have been wrong, and it was not used.

`Clause-②: no` is right. No published schema, export or authorable surface changes. The guide now describes the narrowing that #30902 already shipped and declared; it adds none.

`Metadata-protocol: none` is right. Nothing changes in what a metadata author can write.

Both lines appear line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Eval set** (`skills/objectui/evals/i18n.json`). No case grades anything the new guide contradicts. Case 1's `must_not_contain: "import zh from './zh.json'"` grades an app's own JSON import, not a built-in pack key, so leaving it is right. Case 1's `must_contain: "lazy"` grades the answer: the only lowercase "lazy" in the guide was in deleted bullet 4, but § Lazy language loading still teaches the pattern, so the case stays supported. Case 3's `"direction"` is still supported by the hook example and Common mistakes after deletion 3.
- **The body's out-of-scope finding is real.** On `main`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx` `BUILT_IN_LABELS` is keyed `en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru`, `ar`. It has no `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` or `pt-BR`, so `localeLabel()` names those three through `Intl.DisplayNames`, not with the table's `label`. Its doc comment still calls `pt-BR` "an app-shipped locale". A REST issue search for it finds only the closed #30511, so it is not filed. It belongs in a card of its own (app-shell, outside this card's surface), not in this PR.
- **Sweep of other skills.** The rest of `skills/` on the head has no retired `zh` or `pt` pack key, path or `value="zh"`.

### ④ Design judgment

- **The switcher reads the table, not a hand list.** It maps `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, so a tag added to the table appears without editing the guide, and it shows the table's own `label`. That is what the card asked for (Wanted 1). The hook also exposes `offerableLanguages` (built-in tags plus app locales from `config.resources` or `loadLocales`), which a table-fed menu omits. The card asked for the table, and only the table carries labels, so this is noted, not a finding.
- **S1 (should-fix): the switcher's `value={language}` can match no option.** The fix uses `resolveBuiltInLanguage`, which the guide's own L33 already names:

  ```tsx
  value={resolveBuiltInLanguage(language) ?? language}
  ```

  The context's `language` is the code the instance runs in, and that can be a stored alias. A stored explicit choice `zh` boots as `zh`: `resolveBootstrapConfig` sets `defaultLanguage: stored`, and `zh` is exactly what the previous guide's `value="zh"` switcher wrote. A seed `zh-CN` boots as `zh-CN` through `resolveSeedLanguage` → `matchLanguageTag` exact hit. A host's `changeLanguage(sys_user.locale)` behaves the same way. The UI then renders in Chinese while the controlled `select` has no matching option and shows its first option, "English". The fence is `os:check`-marked and still compiles. Paying for the extra tokens needs one more same-file deletion, because headroom is 1.
- **The inline-map section (L128–142, `zh-CN` keys) is consistent with the renamed keys and does not contradict them.** The inline map and the pack keys are different questions. `InlineLocaleMapSchema` admits any BCP-47 tag and its own example and refusal message use `zh-CN`. `pickLocalized({ en, 'zh-CN' }, 'zh-Hans')` misses exactly (`zh-Hans`) and misses on the base (`zh`), then the regional limb serves the `zh-CN` entry. "Write the tag" (L33) is scoped to stored and pack codes. Leaving out a `zh-Hant` example is defensible: a map `{ 'zh-CN', 'zh-TW' }` would be resolved for a `zh-Hant` viewer by first-key order through that same regional limb, so an example could teach a wrong pick. A `zh-Hant` viewer of the guide's `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` map is served the Simplified entry by the regional limb. That is existing `pickLocalized` behaviour that the guide does not misstate.
- **Budget.** The head file is 5648 bytes, and ceil(5648/4) = 1412. The ceiling is 1413 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1077`, unchanged on the head). `main` is 5652 bytes = 1413. The guide is within the ceiling, with 1 token of headroom and no ratchet raise.
- **Check-runs on the head** (53, read 2026-11-06T20:18Z): 36 success, 8 skipped, 9 in progress, 0 failed. The 9 in progress are Test Core 1/8 and 2/8, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, and Type Check · debt ledger, consumer gates and workspace. Lint · docs & code guards, Check Changeset and the Governed Surface Queue Guard are green. The verdict does not wait on the runs still in progress.

Findings: must-fix none; should-fix S1 (the switcher's `value` binding for an instance running in a stored alias).

This is a delta review of round 1 (PASS at `291ef83d8`, one should-fix, S1). The delta is `git diff 291ef83d8 450d72405`: one commit, `450d72405` "docs(skills): objectui i18n switcher selects the active language when it runs in a stored alias", which touches only `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` (+2 −4). There was no rebase. The merge base with `origin/main` is still `9d939c582`.

It touches `ui/packages/types` only, which does not overlap this PR's two paths, so no merge is owed. The net diff against `main` is still the same two files: `.changeset/objectui-i18n-guide-locale-tags.md` (unchanged since round 1) and `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md`. I re-read the new PR body.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The new import exists in the `@object-ui/i18n` entry.** The switcher fence now imports `{ resolveBuiltInLanguage, useObjectTranslation } from '@object-ui/i18n'`. `ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts` on `main` re-exports `resolveBuiltInLanguage` from `./locales/registry.js`, next to `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` and `loadBuiltInLocale`, and the package's `.` export serves that entry. Its signature is `(lang: string) => string | null`, so `resolveBuiltInLanguage(language) ?? language` is a `string`, which a `select` value accepts. The fence is still `os:check`-marked, and the body reports `check:skill-examples` `i18n.md:38 marked pass` with the new import.
- **The binding fixes S1.** `value={resolveBuiltInLanguage(language) ?? language}`. The function reads the code through `platformLocaleTagOf` and then each shorter prefix, so every alias case that round 1 traced now selects a table tag that has an option:
  - a stored choice `zh` (booted as `zh` by `resolveBootstrapConfig`) selects `zh-Hans`;
  - a seed `zh-CN` (booted as `zh-CN` by `resolveSeedLanguage`) selects `zh-Hans`;
  - `zh-TW` and `zh-Hant-TW` select `zh-Hant`;
  - `pt` selects `pt-BR`;
  - `en-US` selects `en`.

  A table tag resolves to itself, so a plain switch round-trips unchanged. A code with no built-in pack (an app locale such as `th`) falls back to `language`. That locale is outside the table-fed menu, as round 1 noted under `offerableLanguages`. The fix agrees with L33 of the guide, which names `resolveBuiltInLanguage` as the reader of the read aliases. `onChange` still writes the table tag, which keeps L33's "Write the tag" true.
- **Deletion 5 lost no unique fact.** The deleted line is the § Language-aware + responsive page intro "When combining with `@object-ui/mobile` for responsive layouts:". The facts it carried are that the package is `@object-ui/mobile` and that the purpose is responsive layout:
  - the package survives in the fence's `import { useBreakpoint } from '@object-ui/mobile'`;
  - the purpose survives in the heading ("responsive page") and in the fence's `isMobile ? mobilePageSchema : desktopPageSchema`.

  Nothing else in the sentence appears only there.
- **Nothing from round 1 regressed.** The delta changes no other line. The eleven tags, the module paths, the alias sentence, "Write the tag", the setup `'zh-Hans'` key, the table-fed `map`, and round 1's four deletions with their surviving homes are byte-identical to `291ef83d8`. The inline-map section (L128–142) sits above the delta's only deletion, so its line numbers are unchanged.

### ② Semver level

The changeset is unchanged since round 1, and the delta is skill prose only. `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` remain right. Both lines are still line-initial in the PR body and the changeset body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Eval set.** There is no new contact. `skills/objectui/evals/i18n.json` grades nothing about the switcher's `value` binding or the responsive section's intro.
- **The out-of-scope finding is now filed.** `BUILT_IN_LABELS` in the app-shell's `LocaleSwitcher.tsx` is filed as #31045 (open, "app-shell LocaleSwitcher still labels built-in languages from a hand list keyed by the retired zh / pt codes"). Its body cites this review's confirmation on `291ef83d8`. The PR body dropped its out-of-scope section accordingly. Nothing is lost, because the finding now has its own card.
- **Body citation.** The body cites "contract review PASS at `291ef83d8`, comment 6694588461". (Seat note: the dispatching seat posted the round-1 record as that comment; the reviewer wrote it to a file and did not post it.)

### ④ Design judgment

- **S1 is resolved.** The switcher still reads the table, not a hand list, and its controlled `value` now selects the active language when the instance runs in a stored alias.
- **Budget.** The head file is 5643 bytes, and ceil(5643/4) = 1411 (5643 / 4 = 1410.75). The ceiling is 1413 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1077`, unchanged on the head), so headroom is 2 and there is no ratchet raise. The delta is +60 bytes for the import and binding, and −65 bytes for deletion 5 (63 bytes of text plus the blank line), a net of −5 bytes from 5648. This agrees with the body's "+60 bytes" and its 1411 reading.

Still running: Test Core (1/8), and one Check Changeset run (another Check Changeset run on this head is already green). Lint · docs & code guards and the Governed Surface Queue Guard are green.
